description: RockDesk is not installed on this computer, which is why its remote-control tools are missing. Only call this after the user has agreed to install it, with confirm=true. It downloads the official RockDesk package for this system from rockdesk.io (rockdesk.cn in China) and installs it: on Windows the installer runs silently (the user may have to approve a UAC prompt), on macOS RockDesk is copied into Applications and opened, on Linux the .deb is installed with apt (needs administrator rights). When it finishes, the RockDesk tools are loaded here.

confirm.description: true once the user has agreed to install RockDesk on this computer

name: install_rockdesk
title: Install RockDesk
